thesis: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE: BMY), Q3 2026 10-Q (0000014272-26-000024, filed 2026-10-29). Q3 revenue 13,069M vs 12,222M (+6.9%), 9M 37,532M vs 35,692M (+5.2%). Growth Portfolio 9M 21,448M +12.8% (Camzyos +60.9%, Reblozyl +22.8%, Breyanzi +47.2%, Cobenfy 176M); Legacy 16,114M -3.4% (Revlimid -54.2%, Pomalyst -58.5%, Opdivo -4.8%, Eliquis +21.1%). 9M GAAP NI 8,156M vs 5,967M (tax rate 17.3% vs 24.0%; amortization of intangibles 1,332M vs 2,491M; acquired IPRD 1,651M vs 2,328M). TTM (FY2025 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 50,034M, NI 9,243M, OCF 10,652M, capex 1,366M, FCF 9,286M, SBC 552M (FCF after SBC 8,734M). 9M OCF fell to 8,678M from 12,182M, largely a rebates and discounts swing of (3,869)M vs +1,957M. Close 63.43 on 2026-11-13 (stockanalysis, Yahoo agree), 2,044,085,831 shares (cover 2026-10-21): market cap 129.7B, 14.0x TTM GAAP NI, FCF yield 7.2% (6.7% after SBC); aggregator forward P/E 9.8, EV/EBITDA 8.9, dividend yield 4.0%. TTM dividends 5,119M (FCF covers 1.8x). Cash 9,574M plus marketable securities 3,385M; short-term debt 1,028M, long-term debt 41,849M, net debt about 29.9B; total liabilities 65,368M, equity 23,404M. The market likely prices the 2028 era Eliquis and Opdivo exclusivity losses and Revlimid and Pomalyst erosion; evidence that differs is Growth Portfolio compounding at 13% and falling debt (long-term debt 44.8B to 42.6B including current in 9M). Cheap on forward earnings, but forward earnings and Eliquis strength are the key unverified inputs.
counterthesis: Eliquis (13.3B in 9M, 35% of revenue) and Opdivo face loss of exclusivity around 2028 (not verified from the 10-Q; MD&A truncated) and Medicare price negotiation; Eliquis +25% in Q3 needs an explanation (not read). Legacy erosion of Revlimid and Pomalyst is steep. GAAP earnings are flattered by lower amortization and a low tax rate (14.8% in Q3), and IPRD charges of 1.6B in Q3 (600M Hengrui, 500M BioNTech) recur with deals. Net debt 29.9B; 9M OCF fell 29% on rebates. Pipeline setbacks, impairments (834M in 9M) and IRS transfer pricing appeals (2008 to 2012) are risks. Guidance, IRA, LOE dates, peers and non-GAAP reconciliation not read.
invalidation: Thesis fails if Eliquis or Opdivo erosion arrives early, Growth Portfolio growth falls below about 8%, OCF stays below 10B with dividends rising, or pipeline write-offs and IPRD charges keep absorbing cash.
